exposure: lower dose of bupivacaine with fentanyl
conventional dose of bupivacaine with fentanyl
cohort: 90 patients undergoing elective cesarean section under spinal anesthesia
finding: Adding fentanyl to a lower dose of bupivacaine for spinal anesthesia in cesarean sections provided comparable anesthesia to a conventional dose of bupivacaine, with lower risk of hypotension and longer postoperative analgesia.
